1.consolidated_definition: Cada uno tiene su alguacil. Es frase con que se contesta aquella otra: “cada guaraguao tiene su pitirre”.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Each one has its own constable. This is a phrase used in response to the statement "each guaraguao has its pitirre".
